name: FishMonger’s arsenal upgraded: SprySOCKS for Windows.
description: ESET researchers have identified two undocumented Windows variants of the FishMonger backdoor, SprySOCKS, which was previously known only in its Linux iteration. These Windows variants, designated as WIN_DRV and WIN_PLUS, have demonstrated active usage targeting government organizations across Honduras, Taiwan, Thailand, and Pakistan from 2023 to 2024. Both variants operate with a hardcoded command and control (C&C) configuration that supports communication via TCP, UDP, and WebSocket protocols and can execute over 30 C&C commands, including file management and system information retrieval.
